purpose: Fail-closed aggregate registration receipt for exactly one held non-array LSF job. The validator derives scheduler state and duplicate-job facts from an A-side raw bjobs capture; it does not trust hand-filled booleans or counts.
raw_capture_storage_rule: The command output remains only in the A-side evidence directory. Git contains this schema and aggregate SHA-256 values, never bjobs rows.
real_lsf_fixture_capture: A-side no-BLIND /bin/sleep 2 probe verified the custom bjobs row and separate no-JOBID global bjobs snapshot on LSF 9.1.3.0. submit_time is opaque scheduler text and is retained byte-for-byte as submit_time_raw, never parsed as ISO-Z.
frozen_bjobs_capture_command: bjobs -noheader -o "jobid stat user queue command from_host submit_time effective_resreq output_file error_file sub_cwd delimiter='^'" JOBID
raw_bjobs_line_rule: A target capture must contain exactly one nonempty line. Splitting it on '^' must yield exactly 11 printed LSF fields; LSF 9.1 does not emit a required empty terminal delimiter field. No field may contain '^' or untrimmed whitespace.

job_template_mapping.registration.initial_scheduler_state: derived from raw bjobs stat and must be PSUSP
job_template_mapping.registration.array_allowed/retry_allowed: derived fail-closed requirements; these booleans are not copied into the receipt

validation.draft_and_final_rule: DRAFT_NO_EXECUTION is documentation only and cannot validate a registration. A final registration requires FINAL_HELD_JOB_TEMPLATE and FINAL_HELD_UNSEAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED with no null or DRAFT/PENDING digest value.
required_derived_facts: contract and job-template file byte SHA-256 values equal receipt
global held-job snapshot hash is receipt-bound
global held-job snapshot has exactly one target identity while unrelated held jobs remain allowed
validation.cycle_rule: Order is implementation-freeze commit -> bsub -H -> raw bjobs capture -> final template -> stable final contract -> registration receipt -> final job spec -> independent review -> clean commit -> bresume. The receipt binds the already-final contract and template only. A final job spec may bind receipt SHA-256, and review may bind job-spec SHA-256. No artifact hashes a future artifact that hashes it back.
validation.argv_rule: normalized_argv_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with separators ',' and ':'.
